For 20 delivery vehicles in Ahmedabad, I’d compare:

Option	Price*	Features	Availability
LocoNav	Hardware ₹2,284–₹4,539/device; software quote-based	Live tracking, alerts, fleet management	Pan-India; demos available 
LocoNav

WheelsEye	~₹3,400+/vehicle/year in a published quotation	GPS tracking, geofencing, support	Strong India coverage; get current Ahmedabad quote 
Scribd

FleetTrace	₹249/vehicle/month annual = ₹4,980/month for 20	Tracking, dispatch, geofencing, maintenance, API, customer portal	India-hosted; supports AIS-140/GT06/Teltonika 
FleetTrace

*Prices can vary by hardware, SIM, installation and contract.

My pick: FleetTrace for transparent pricing and broader operations features; LocoNav if you want an established tracker ecosystem.

Locally, Ahmedabad has multiple GPS installers, including trackNOW pvt ltd and GeoSafe.
